test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
Performance of 1800 students in grades has been shown in the following pie chart.

How many students have got either grade D or grade E?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8a1903948867e2c007d9789c5bb58773f0a20dcbc5e950e932b4d1d1b4a6fc0.png]
solution:
**Given data:**

Students with either Grade D or Grade E = 11 + 8 = 19%

Total students = 1800

**Calculation:**

Total students with either Grade D or Grade E = 19over100 × 1800 = 342

∴ **Total students with either Grade D or Grade E is 342.**
